requiredReadOnlyEvidence: Exact identityResolutionLinks and shopperIdentityCrosswalk records for these six source IDs; include matching exact field and canonical target.

Read tenant/project/period scope, status, authorityType, authorityRef, adjudicationId, providerAckRef, commandId, idempotencyKey and nested authority references when present.
Read only the referenced durable command/adjudication receipts and check operation, committed state, exact alias/target, scope and provider ACK.
forbiddenInferences: Do not approve by shared destination alone.

nextDecisionRule: If current durable authority already proves an exact alias, repair only the QA reader/diagnostic owner with positive and negative tests. If authority is missing, retain HOLD and resolve under the existing functional contract and authorization; no silent alias acceptance.
